column1: The new coffee shop around the corner has cozy seating and great espresso.
Waited forty minutes for cold food and unhelpful service.
The presentation was decent enough, nothing groundbreaking though.
Battery life on this phone lasts all day even with heavy use.
The app crashes every time I try to export my report.
Such a smooth checkout process—ordered in under a minute.
The plot dragged in the second half and felt predictable.
Customer support resolved my billing issue quickly and politely.
